description: Fan out several delegates in one call. Each task inherits the batch-level model, cwd, tools and extensions unless it overrides them. The whole batch is validated before any delegate starts, so a bad model name or a duplicate id fails everything instead of leaving half a fan-out running. Wait for the batch with `wait` and the returned sessionIds, rather than polling `sessions` or one `status` per delegate.

attachments.description: Default for every task in this batch. Absolute paths of text files appended to the prompt, read by this server, e.g. a diff you wrote to your scratchpad; they may lie outside cwd. At most 20, 256 KiB each, 1 MiB in total; secret paths are refused.

cwd.description: Default working directory for every task in this batch

durable.description: Default for every task in this batch. Default false: memory only, nothing written, gone when this MCP process exits; right for short, cheap, re-runnable work such as reviews, searches and model comparisons. Pass true when the work is long, has external side effects, should survive an MCP restart, or needs disk retention. Memory sessions can follow_up while retained in this process.

extensions.description: Default extensions setting for every task in this batch

forkFrom.description: Default settled parent session for this batch

maxDurationMs.description: Default wall-clock deadline; server ceiling 900000 ms

maxToolCalls.description: Default cap on each delegate's own tool calls

mcpServers.description: Default native MCP server selection for this batch

model.description: Default model for every task in this batch

nativeMcp.description: Default native MCP setting for this batch

retentionDays.description: Default for every task in this batch. Durable only: days to keep it on disk after it finishes (default 7, max 365). Set it longer when the user wants to come back to this session later.

saveDir.description: Absolute directory: each finished task's final text is written to <sessionId>.md there

attachments.description: Overrides the batch `attachments` for this task alone; [] attaches nothing

cwd.description: Overrides the batch `cwd` for this task alone

durable.description: Overrides the batch `durable` for this task alone

forkFrom.description: Overrides the batch forkFrom for this task

id.description: Session id for this task. Defaults to `idPrefix`-NN, or a UUID.

maxToolCalls.description: Overrides the batch `maxToolCalls` for this task alone

model.description: Overrides the batch `model` for this task alone

retentionDays.description: Overrides the batch `retentionDays` for this task alone

thinking.description: Overrides the batch `thinking` for this task alone

tools.description: Overrides the batch `tools` for this task alone

thinking.description: Default thinking level for every task in this batch; omit to use pi settings

tools.description: Default tool allowlist for every task in this batch

name: spawn_batch
